function readNumeric<T extends { [key: `${number}`]: string }>(table: T): string {
  const first: string = table[1];
  return first;
}
function writeNumeric<T extends { [key: `${number}`]: string }>(table: T): void {
  table[1] = "a";
}
function readNamed<T extends { name: string }>(record: T): number {
  const name: number = record["name"];
  return name;
}
function writeThroughIndex<T extends Record<string, number>>(scores: T, key: string): void {
  scores[key] = 1;
  scores["total"] += 1;
  scores.average = 0;
}
function writeNumbered<T extends { [index: number]: string }>(items: T): void {
  items[0] = "first";
}
function readUnconstrained<T>(value: T): unknown {
  return value[0];
}
console.log(readNumeric({ "0": "a" }), readNamed({ name: "b" }), writeNumbered, writeNumeric, writeThroughIndex, readUnconstrained);
